layouts.name: Grand Prix, Sprint configuration preview
layouts.description: Draft preview follows the OSM ways tagged Nürburgring Sprintstrecke and closes at the mapped timing-node way. The official full Grand Prix configuration is 5.148 km. This mapped loop is about 3.61 km; its relation to the full configuration needs route research.

layouts.name: Nordschleife full circuit
layouts.description: Draft loop assembled along connected OSM raceway ways, retaining mapped one-way directions. The trace measures about 20.73 km against the operator reference of 20.832 km. Visual review and exact route closure review are still required.
